game.notFoundHint: Deadlock was not found in your Steam libraries. Set the game folder in settings.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.searchNote: Category and sort do not apply to name search; that is how the GameBanana API works.
catalog.empty: Nothing found. Change the query or clear the category.

drawer.unsupported: {{ext}} is not supported yet. Use .zip, .7z, .rar or .vpk.
drawer.av: GameBanana: scan failed or not finished
drawer.noFiles: This mod has no downloadable files.

library.title: Library
library.subtitle: Mods installed through the manager. The slot number sets the load order.
library.empty: Nothing installed yet. Find a mod in the catalog and press Install.
library.foreign: Other addons in the game folder
library.foreignNote: Installed by other managers or by hand. This manager never changes or deletes them.
library.orderNote: Higher in the list means a lower slot number. When two mods change the same file the game decides; we assume the lower number wins, but this has not been verified in the game yet. Drag a mod by its plate or use the arrows.
library.reordered: Mod order changed. You can undo it.
library.checkOffline: No connection, data may be out of date.
library.updated: “{{name}}” updated. Slot and state are kept; you can undo this.
library.patchTitle: The game was updated after these mods were installed
library.patchText: Mods installed on an older build: {{count}}. Current game build is {{build}}. A patch can break mods, so check for updates. If the author has not released one, the mod has to wait.

activity.overlaps_one: Files overlap with one installed addon. If they differ, the addon with higher priority wins.
activity.overlaps_other: Files overlap with {{count}} addons. If they differ, the addon with higher priority wins.

errors.game_not_found: Deadlock not found. Make sure the game is installed through Steam.
errors.no_files: The mod has no files to install.
errors.unsupported_format: File “{{name}}” has an unsupported format. You can install .zip, .7z, .rar and .vpk.
errors.duplicate: The same set of files is already in the addons folder: {{name}}. No need to install it again.
errors.no_free_slots: No free slots left: 99 mods maximum.
errors.network: Could not reach GameBanana. Check your connection, enable a proxy or switch the mirror in settings.
errors.encrypted: The archive is password-protected. The manager cannot open those.
errors.forbidden: The archive contains executables or scripts. Mods may only contain assets, so installation was stopped.
errors.unsafe: The archive contains unsafe paths. Installation was stopped and game files were not changed.
errors.badArchive: The file does not look like a mod archive or is damaged. Try downloading it again.
errors.name_taken: A profile with this name already exists. Choose another.
errors.invalid_name: The name is too long or contains control characters.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large to be a profile.
errors.not_a_profile: This file does not look like a mod manager profile.
errors.unsupported_version: This profile was made by a newer version of the manager. Update the app.
errors.bad_profile: The profile file is damaged or contains invalid data.
errors.mirrors_empty: At least one mirror address is required.
errors.mirror_bad: The mirror address “{{value}}” is not accepted. Use https://example.org without credentials or parameters (http is allowed for localhost only).
errors.proxy_incomplete: A custom proxy needs a host and a port from 1 to 65535.
errors.proxy_host: The proxy host must be a bare host name or IP, without http:// or a path.
errors.proxy_bad: Could not apply the proxy settings. Check the host and port.
errors.not_deadlock: This is not a Deadlock folder: game/citadel/gameinfo.gi is missing. Choose the game folder: {{path}}
errors.order_mismatch: The mod list does not match what is installed. Reload and try again.
errors.updates_not_configured: No update source is set. Add an address in settings.
errors.update_install_failed: Could not install the update: {{message}}. Restart the app.
errors.update_signature: The update signature failed verification, installation stopped. Try another mirror.
errors.no_update: There is no update for this mod.
errors.update_no_source: The manager does not remember which file this mod was installed from, so versions cannot be compared. Remove the mod and install it again from the catalog; updates will work after that.
errors.update_slot_conflict: The new version needs more slots than the old one and the next slot is taken. The old version was restored. Remove or move a neighbouring mod and try again.
errors.mod_not_found: The mod was not found in the library.
errors.already_queued: This mod is already in the download queue.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: A profile remembers which mods are enabled and in what order. Switching enables and disables installed mods in one action.
profiles.empty: No profiles yet. Set up your mods in the library and save the set, for example “Ranked” without skins.
profiles.appliedMissing: Not installed: {{count}}. Find them in the catalog to complete the profile.
profiles.imported: Profile “{{name}}” imported. Its mods are not installed automatically.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Network, mirrors and game folder. Changes apply right after saving, no restart needed.

game.title: Game folder
game.none: Game not found. Choose the folder manually.
game.hint: Use the game root, for example …\steamapps\common\Deadlock. When a path is set, auto-detection is not used.

proxy.title: Proxy

modeHint.none: Direct connection, the system proxy is ignored.

proxy.passwordKept: Saved, leave empty to keep it
proxy.plain: The password is stored unencrypted in the settings file on this computer. Do not use a password you use elsewhere.

mirrors.title: GameBanana mirrors
mirrors.hint: One address per line. The first is primary; the others are tried in order when it is unreachable. https only (http is allowed for localhost).

diag.title: Network diagnostics
diag.hint: Checks step by step: name resolution, connection, secure channel and the server reply. Shows where the connection breaks.

dns_failed.title: Name does not resolve
dns_failed.advice: The site name could not be turned into an IP. This can happen when the provider blocks it at DNS. Try a proxy or change DNS in the Windows network settings.

tcp_failed.title: No connection
tcp_failed.advice: The server does not accept the connection. This may be an IP block or a network fault. Try a proxy or another mirror.

tls_failed.title: Dropped while opening the secure channel
tls_failed.advice: The connection opens but the secure channel fails. This can look like a block by site name; antivirus software and certificate substitution also cause it. Try a proxy or a mirror.

proxy_failed.title: Proxy does not answer
proxy_failed.advice: The request through the proxy failed. Check the type, host, port and credentials, and that the proxy program is running.

http_failed.title: Server returns an error
http_failed.advice: The link works, but the server returned an error or did not answer in time. Try later or another mirror.

bad_url.title: Invalid address
bad_url.advice: The mirror address is malformed. Fix it above.

updates.title: App updates
updates.none: No update source is set in this build
updates.hint: One address per line: GitHub Releases first, then mirrors. Only the version list file is requested and nothing about you is sent. Packages are verified with the signing key built into the app, so a mirror cannot deliver a foreign build.

update.hint: Currently {{current}}. The package signature is verified before installing.
update.installing: Downloading and verifying the signature. The app restarts by itself.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.subtitle: Mods download one at a time, in the order they were added. Pause and resume whenever you like: the downloaded part is kept, even across restarts.
downloads.empty: No downloads. Pick a mod in the catalog and press Install: it joins the queue and installs itself after downloading.
